The '''CR-2 heavy blaster pistol''' was a basic yet durable [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. They were famous for being able to deflect off certain surfaces yet penetrate [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

[[File:CR-2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The CR-2, standard weapon of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].]]
The CR-2 blaster was a basic [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] design created by the little-known [[Corellian Arms/Legends|Corellian Arms]] corporation, and was the first mass-produced version of the modern blaster weapon introduced on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The CR-2 primarily fired bolts of charged [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] energy, but a secondary firing mode allowed the weapon to discharge electrical [[Stun charge (projectile)|charges]] capable of [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] most living targets.<ref name="NEGWT" /> It had a high rate of fire, crossing into the realm of fully-automatic. The CR-2 pistol became an antique on most [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] long before the Naboo Security Forces adopted it as the standard-issue sidearm for its [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guards]] and [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. Ranchers and wilderness guides were also known to have used the CR-2 as added protection.

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] used a twin-bolt variant known as the [[R-65 heavy blaster|R-65]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CR-2 is a cosmetically modified [[Wikipedia:Calico 960|Calico M960]] pistol without the [[Stock/Legends|retractable stock]].
